title: Screen-Free Activities for Kids: Meet Bramblewicks
description: Every great agent starts with curiosity. Meet Bramblewicks, Keeper of the Files, and discover a story-led nature adventure for your family. Explore the printable Gaia’s Secret Agents Starter Kit for screen-free activities, secret-agent play and time together. Tap to see what is inside.
alt_text: A red fox wearing a peacock-blue coat sits in a magical archive beneath the words Every Great Agent Starts With Curiosity.

title: Outdoor Family Activities: More Wonder, More Time Together
description: Make family time an adventure. Slow down, look closely and share what you discover outdoors. Gaia’s Secret Agents offers screen-free nature missions for curious families. Start with the free printable secret-agent mission; a parent or guardian email is required. Save this for your next family adventure.
board: Screen free printable games for the family
alt_text: A family sits beneath a tree under a starry sky with the words More Wonder. More Together.

title: Nature Walk Activity for Kids: A One-Minute Listening Mission
description: Try this simple outdoor listening activity together: stand still, listen for three different sounds and share what you noticed. An easy nature-study idea for a family walk or homeschool break. Save the prompt, then explore more screen-free nature activities and sound-map ideas from Gaia’s Secret Agents.
alt_text: A kookaburra watches from a gum tree above a child and older adult, beside three steps for a family listening activity.

title: Ocean Activities for Kids: Meet Flip the Dolphin
description: Let curiosity lead the way. Meet Flip, the dolphin Ocean Scout, and explore screen-free ocean activities for kids and families. Discover beach observations, at-home investigations and simple ways to care for the sea together. Save this ocean adventure inspiration and tap for the free activity guide.
alt_text: Flip the bottlenose dolphin swims through bright blue water beneath the words Let Curiosity Lead the Way.

title: Free Printable Nature Mission: Your Family’s Next Adventure
description: Turn outdoor time into a secret-agent adventure. Try the free nine-page Nature Signal mission with printable code-name wheels, a nature hunt and an Earth Protector Promise. Designed for children aged 6–11, with grown-ups joining the adventure. A parent or guardian email is required. Tap to begin.
alt_text: A top-secret envelope and compass sit beside a lush forest trail beneath the words Your Family’s Next Adventure Starts Here.

title: Backyard Nature Activity for Kids: A Tiny-World Safari
description: Go slow and spot more. Pause beside a plant, look for tiny movements and watch without disturbing wildlife. This simple backyard nature activity gives families and homeschoolers a reason to explore together. Save the three-step prompt, then visit Gaia’s Secret Agents for more mini nature missions.
alt_text: A smiling parent and child observe a snail on a leaf, with three steps for a tiny-world safari.

title: Low-Waste Family Picnic: A Simple Earth Protector Challenge
description: Pack a picnic and skip the wrappers. Use a reusable lunchbox, bring refillable bottles and take your rubbish home. A practical sustainability activity for kids and families to try on their next outdoor adventure. Save these picnic tips, then explore more family nature missions from Gaia’s Secret Agents.
alt_text: A parent and child share a picnic beside a reusable lunchbox and water bottle, with three tips for reducing picnic waste.
